items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: You said he was powerful. Yes, when Lee came here, he stopped at this hotel on Belmont Street, and he called up his house.

ctx.x: We were talking about Lee Collins. You said he was powerful.
Yes, when Lee came here, he stopped at this hotel on Belmont Street, and he called up his house. My wife and my mother got killed in my car. I was living here alone.
